description: Android Home activity class implementing launcher UI with application grid, favorites, recents, wallpaper management, and menu options.

classes.name: Home
classes.description: Main activity class for Android launcher, managing application grid, favorites, recents, wallpaper, and menu.

classes.name: ApplicationsAdapter
classes.description: ArrayAdapter for displaying installed applications in grid view.

classes.name: ShowApplications
classes.description: OnClickListener to toggle application grid visibility.

classes.name: HideGrid
classes.description: AnimationListener to handle end of hide animation.

classes.name: ShowGrid
classes.description: AnimationListener to handle end of show animation.

classes.name: ClippedDrawable
classes.description: Drawable that clips wallpaper to avoid stretching.

methods.name: onCreate
methods.description: Initializes activity, sets layout, registers receivers, loads applications, binds UI components.

methods.name: onNewIntent
methods.description: Handles new intents, closes panels if main action.

methods.name: onDestroy
methods.description: Cleans up resources, unregisters receivers.

methods.name: onResume
methods.description: Refreshes recents list.

methods.name: onRestoreInstanceState
methods.description: Restores UI state, shows applications if needed.

methods.name: onSaveInstanceState
methods.description: Saves UI state regarding application grid visibility.

methods.name: registerIntentReceivers
methods.description: Registers broadcast receivers for wallpaper and package changes.

methods.name: bindApplications
methods.description: Sets up application grid adapter.

methods.name: bindButtons
methods.description: Binds click actions to UI buttons.

methods.name: setDefaultWallpaper
methods.description: Sets default wallpaper if none is set.

methods.name: bindFavorites
methods.description: Loads favorites from XML and binds to UI.

methods.name: beginDocument
methods.description: Helper to parse XML document start.

methods.name: nextElement
methods.description: Helper to move to next XML element.

methods.name: bindRecents
methods.description: Loads recent tasks and binds to UI.

methods.name: getApplicationInfo
methods.description: Resolves application info from intent.

methods.name: onWindowFocusChanged
methods.description: Resets key flags when window focus changes.

methods.name: dispatchKeyEvent
methods.description: Handles back and home key events.

methods.name: onCreateOptionsMenu
methods.description: Creates options menu with wallpaper, search, and settings.

methods.name: onOptionsItemSelected
methods.description: Handles menu item selections.

methods.name: startWallpaper
methods.description: Launches wallpaper picker.

methods.name: loadApplications
methods.description: Loads installed applications into list.

methods.name: showApplications
methods.description: Animates and displays application grid.

methods.name: hideApplications
methods.description: Animates and hides application grid.
